build.buildCommand: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @pims/db exec prisma generate && pnpm --filter @pims/entry run build

deploy.startCommand: pnpm --filter @pims/db exec prisma migrate deploy && pnpm --filter @pims/db exec tsx prisma/seed.ts && pnpm --filter @pims/entry exec next start -p $PORT
